commands.command:
set -euo pipefail; python3 - <<'PY'
import re, subprocess
from pathlib import Path
script = subprocess.check_output(['git','show','origin/agent-control:.agent/scripts/20260918-developer-tools-scope-cleanup-v74.py'], text=True)
old = "all_mobile = '\\n'.join(p.read_text() for p in path('apps/mobile/src').rglob('*') if p.suffix in {'.ts', '.tsx'})"
new = "all_mobile = '\\n'.join(p.read_text() for base in [path('apps/mobile/src/screens'), path('apps/mobile/src/flows')] for p in base.rglob('*') if p.suffix in {'.ts', '.tsx'})"
if old not in script:
    raise SystemExit('guard patch target missing')
script = script.replace(old, new, 1)
exec(compile(script, 'developer-tools-scope-cleanup-v74.py', 'exec'))

ux = Path('scripts/quality/ux-gate.mjs')
ux_text = ux.read_text()
legacy_page = "  'apps/mobile/src/screens/hardware-setup/pages/DiagnosticsSetupPage.tsx',\n"
if ux_text.count(legacy_page) != 1:
    raise SystemExit(f'ux gate legacy diagnostics path count={ux_text.count(legacy_page)}')
ux.write_text(ux_text.replace(legacy_page, '', 1))

test = Path('apps/mobile/src/__tests__/hardware-setup.test.tsx')
text = test.read_text().rstrip()
if text.splitlines()[-1].startswith('  ') and text.splitlines()[-1].strip() == '});':
    text += '\n});'
text = re.sub(r'^\s*diagnosticShellyId:\s*[^\n]+\n', '', text, flags=re.MULTILINE)
test.write_text(text + '\n')
PY
